B2LT.source: Byte-identical copy of audited Exp18d matrices; independently re-audited

accounting: Exp18 GDP whole fixed-epoch matrix mechanism; no sampling amplification
evaluation: Internal validation each epoch; all 872 official validation examples once at final step; no early stopping
gpu: All four physical GPUs, UUID isolation, free-memory-aware scheduler, <=2 workers per GPU, no DDP
historical_results: No historical checkpoints, metrics or seeds used as formal results
optimizer: Exact exp18.optimizer.Update for Adam/Momentum/STP-Ex2, beta1=.9, beta2=.999, weight_decay=0
participation: Same per-seed Exp16e permutation repeated five epochs
privacy_scope: epsilon=8,delta=1e-5 per training; composition of search and formal runs is not jointly epsilon=8; raw internal diagnostics are not DP releases

selection.boundary: After fine ranking: if best is at current observed min/max, multiply that coordinate by 0.5/2; choose at most two in deterministic lr,clip,eps order.
selection.fine: From each of top two coarse winners, one coordinate at a time, geometric midpoint to each adjacent observed coordinate; deduplicate; at most 14.
selection.official_validation: No search worker loads official tokens; only formal workers after freeze.
selection.ranking: final-step internal accuracy mean over both methods/seeds descending, then loss mean ascending
selection.review: Top two after coarse/fine/boundary; final selection uses ONLY review-seed means over both methods.

smoke: Six methods, seed 20261111, 3 steps, batch 1000, length128, internal validation64; separate directories
statistics: 5 paired seeds; sample SD ddof=1, Student-t 95% CI for accuracy and loss and paired differences
stpex2: d0=1; scale by previous completed d; adaptive alpha, 24 bisections, 1e-6 backoff; no final denominator
stpex2_parameters: Pending common NLP search; both STP methods share one frozen triplet
